<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with relative intensities of ~100 %, 20 %, 2 %, etc., matching the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing ~18 carbons. No other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) fits these intensities, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
